title: zamia altensteinii
intro: Zamia altensteinii, commonly known as the Cycad or Palma de Cera, is a type of gymnosperm plant that belongs to the family Zamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with health benefits including its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Zamia altensteinii are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, lower blood sugar levels, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Zamia altensteinii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
